# Soviet and post-Soviet CC0 environment models

This folder contains third-party environment models selected for the Kromka
strategic map. All six source pages mark the downloads as **CC0 1.0**. The
models may therefore be used, modified, and redistributed without attribution.
Source information is retained here so the asset provenance remains auditable.

## Sources

- `SovietPanelHouse/` — **Soviet Panel Apartment House 3D**, GGBotNet.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/soviet-panel-apartment-house-3d
  Download: `Soviet_Panel_Apartment_House_3D.zip`.
- `ResidentialBlock/` — **Residential building (lowpoly apartment block)**,
  Mixazzz (M. Khludeev).
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/residential-building-lowpoly-apartment-block
  Download: `residential-building-lowpoly-apartment-block.zip`.
- `SovietGarage/` — **Soviet Metal Garage 3D**, GGBotNet.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/soviet-metal-garage-3d
  Download: `SMGarage.zip`.
- `ElectricalSubstation/` — **Electrical Substation 3D**, GGBotNet.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/electrical-substation-3d
  Download: `ElectricalSubstation3D.zip`.
- `PostSovietFence/` — **Post-soviet fence PO-2 and grate**, Mixazzz
  (M. Khludeev).
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/post-soviet-fence-po-2-and-grate
  Download: `post-soviet-fence-po-2-and-grate.zip`.

- `IndustrialWarehouse/` — **Warehouse building, low poly**, 32kda.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/warehouse-building-low-poly
  Download: `warehouse02.zip`. The game-ready GLB mesh was converted to OBJ
  without changing its geometry or embedded CC0 diffuse texture.

License deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Only game-ready model and texture files are kept in the Unity project. Original
archives and authoring-format duplicates remain outside `Assets` under
`Build/` and are not included in player builds.
